name: cascade-c2x-v1
status: EXPLORATORY. Written after the C2 confirmatory null and before any C2x run. Cannot confirm or refute C2 H1; uses the same seeds 901-908, so it is NOT independent evidence.
motivation: C2 confirmatory: 0 breaches in 96 runs; all 768 leveraged agent-observations were SHORT at the shock. Inspection (seeds 901-902): with the whale build-up, funding turns positive (~+0.12%/interval) and leveraged signals are -0.9 to -1.0 with neighbour stance -0.84 to -0.94; without the whale, positioning is mixed.
explanation_under_test: leveraged agents take the opposite side of the whale because (i) their funding term (signal -= clip(funding x funding_sens, +-0.5)) and/or (ii) social herding push them short; therefore the forced sale hits no leveraged longs and no downward cascade can start

X1_positioning.design: whale 2000 BTC (nominal), leverage_use 1.0, base R, runs stop at 899 s (before the shock), seeds 901-908
X1_positioning.measure: number of the 16 leveraged agents long / short at 899 s; mean margin distance downward of longs
X1_positioning.prediction: default: >= 14/16 short in every seed; removing the funding term makes leveraged agents long or mixed (mean longs >= 8/16)
X1_positioning.refuted_if: removing the funding term leaves mean longs < 4/16 AND removing social also leaves mean longs < 4/16

X2_cascade_with_channel_removed.design: same as C2 arms A/B (2000 BTC nominal, leverage_use 1.0, seeds 901-908) under the X1 condition with the most leveraged longs (chosen by the X1 result by the rule: max mean longs; tie -> no_funding_term)
X2_cascade_with_channel_removed.nature: counterfactual model variant for explanation testing only; it is NOT a proposed simulator change and cannot be promoted
X2_cascade_with_channel_removed.measure_and_rules: identical to cascade_c2_v1 (classification rule, incremental drop, chain definition)
X2_cascade_with_channel_removed.prediction: if positioning is the only blocker, secondary breaches appear in arm B and secondary liquidations in arm A in >= 2/8 seeds
X2_cascade_with_channel_removed.refuted_if: 0/8 seeds with secondary breaches although leveraged agents are long at the shock -> margin distance (not positioning) is the binding constraint
